formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P12-R2 — Opportunity-Representation Coordinate-Projection Lattice, Support–Information Pareto Frontier Census, Exact-Table Quotient Dominance, Fresh↔Legacy Frontier Transport, Common-Support Phase Diagram, Threshold-Free Compression Boundary & Representation Identifiability Census

metrics.information_loss: normalized conditional entropy H(K,D,L | projection) / H(K,D,L)
metrics.support: number of solves with lb7 and lb6/8 sharing normalized-progress-quintile × projection
metrics.state_collision: number and mass of distinct exact tuples merged by each projection

pareto_definition.direction: lower information loss and higher common-support solve count are both better
pareto_definition.dominance: projection A dominates B in an ancestry iff A loss <= B loss and A support >= B support with at least one strict inequality
pareto_definition.joint_frontier: projection is joint-Pareto if not dominated under the four-vector (fresh loss↓, fresh support↑, legacy loss↓, legacy support↑)

readouts: whether the same projection order is preserved across ancestries
exact full-table endpoint and singleton-coordinate endpoints
distance of R1 gates from each lattice point, reported descriptively only
forbidden: select a behavioral matching representation in R2
introduce result-triggered bins or rounded continuous coordinates

successor_logic.if_joint_frontier_has_low_loss_high_supp: future behavioral audit may preseal that exact projection in a new operation
successor_logic.otherwise: move to soft/partial matching or model-based structural adjustment only under a new prospective constitution
